purpose: Separate intervention localization, candidate-specific correction and downstream behavioral sensitivity
prior_knowledge: Success tables, rescue/regression counts and uncentered coefficient participation ratios were already inspected. This is not preregistered confirmation.

layer_reanalysis.comparison: Native minus learned, and support-matched random minus learned, divided by native lineage-mean MSE
layer_reanalysis.unit: Original fitting-disjoint development lineage; retain all 33 Reach, 27 Reach-Wall and 21 Push-T units
layer_reanalysis.scope: Recount saved lineage metrics and visualize already-executed rank-one intervention experiments; not attention, a new GPU evaluation, or the later rank-four recipe
layer_reanalysis.inference: Reuse original H6 simultaneous intervals; other horizons descriptive; no new layer winner selection

candidate_decomposition.calls: All H6 calls with 300 candidates and complete 300 by 4 applied coefficient arrays
candidate_decomposition.primary_quantity: Within-call candidate-centered coefficient squared energy divided by total coefficient squared energy; aggregate numerator and denominator within scenario first
secondary_quantities: First versus last iteration of first planning call
candidate_decomposition.identity: Total = within-call centered + between-call centered means + scenario mean squared energy
candidate_decomposition.uncertainty: 20000 scenario bootstrap replicates, seed 20260913; marginal 95 percent intervals for descriptive means only, not a familywise discovery test
candidate_decomposition.interpretation_gate: At least 90 percent mean common energy suggests common-mode coefficient dominance, not constant output shifts or unchanged action ranks
candidate_decomposition.falsifier: Substantial candidate-centered energy weakens common-mode dominance; common-mode dominance in both learned and comparator arms is not learned-direction-specific
candidate_decomposition.exclusions: No outcome-based scenario selection, no candidate-level independent n, no comparing candidate index across diverged searches

gpu_pilot.scope: Existing single-fitting-trajectory native attention observer and optional native candidate trace
gpu_pilot.causal_followup: A separately frozen shared-action-bank mean-only versus candidate-centered edit replay is required before attributing planning effects to common-mode geometry
gpu_pilot.unchanged: No intervention refitting, new protected success panel, automatic successor search or transfer of the closed campaign budget
